info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: The External Agency Lookup API enables users to retrieve information about a specific external agency based on a provided parameter. This endpoint allows consumers to access essential data regarding banking agencies, supporting use cases such as verification and reporting. Typical users of this API include financial institutions, compliance teams, and reporting systems that require up-to-date agency information. By providing detailed insights based on parameterized queries, this API facilitates informed decision-making within financial services.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific product service agency.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific product service agency using its unique identifier. It provides a comprehensive overview of the agency's attributes and functionalities, empowering users to understand its offerings effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve data related to the product service agency with the specified ID. It allows clients to request specific operations or details about the product identified by 'PROD-700045'. Ensure that the structure of the JSON matches the expected schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data retrieved.
